symbols.name: polynomial variable
symbols.meaning: The formal variable of the polynomial ring modulo y^r+1, whose powers are the roots used here.
symbols.quote: Here $y$ is the formal variable of the [polynomial ring modulo $y^r+1$](polynomial-ring.md), changing meaning from the neighbouring vertex of earlier pages.

symbols.name: reduced length
symbols.meaning: The number of complex coefficients of a reduced polynomial, a power of two.
symbols.quote: Here $r$ is the number of complex coefficients of a reduced polynomial, a power of two.

symbols.name: root of unity
symbols.meaning: The primitive q-th root of unity y^(2r/q) in the polynomial ring, for a power of two q dividing 2r.
symbols.quote: For a power of two $q$ dividing $2r$, let $\zeta$ denote $y^{2r/q}$.

symbols.name: exponent of y
symbols.meaning: The exponent with 0 <= p < r such that a power of y equals plus or minus y^p.
symbols.quote: Here $p$ is an exponent with $0\le p<r$, the letter $p$ changing meaning from the fractional bit count.

relations.quote: A root of unity supplies the twiddle factors of a [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) of length $q$.
A root of unity is characterised by the [order of an element](order-of-element.md) it has, the least positive power that equals one.
